scope: Compared the complete Japanese source and all twelve translations, historical framing, Rust/Cargo installation workflow, Hello World code and commands, documentation language, metadata, and internal/external links. Executed the extracted Cargo example.
findings: Replaced the outdated “relatively new” framing with the stable Rust 1.0 release year and removed unsupported company-adoption claims.
Qualified the C++ comparison so it does not imply a universal replacement.
Updated the beginner workflow to rustup, cargo new, src/main.rs, and cargo run.
Added official English documentation while retaining the Japanese book and online playground.
Removed duplicate date keys and recorded lastmod for the editorial update.
